messages:
deploybot: [deploybot] packaging job started for private-vpc installer v1.9.0-rc2, change window 2026-04-07 02:00-03:00 UTC. artifacts: installer.tar.gz, oci-bundle.tar, manifest.json.sig :package:
jordan: quick heads-up — I'm going to run the preflight checklist now. main risks: cosign signing, kms access, and the delta patch metadata mismatch that hit QA yesterday. :eyes:
priaya: noted. i'll watch signing and KMS handoff. if cosign fails we should stop the transport and not push the escort. :+1:
sam: added a script change to validate submanifest chunking. run: ```scripts/verify-submanifest.sh --bundle oci-bundle.tar --manifest manifest.json``` returns 0 on success. ran locally against rc2 and got one missing chunk earlier, fixed in branch release/rc2-subchunk.
tina: can we confirm the offline mirror path has the new shrinkwrap lock? previous customers hit stale layers. ops-bot, do we have current mirror replication status?
ops-bot: Mirror replication status: cluster-vpc-3 -> 100% synced, cluster-offline-1 -> 100% synced. Last replication: 2026-04-06T22:12:18Z. No lag detected. :white_check_mark:
marco: KMS check: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234 is active and key policy allows cosign role. I rotated the signing key yesterday; cosign has the new key installed on the signer host.
jordan: good. two quick questions: 1) rollback plan if cosign or transport fails mid-escort? 2) how are we naming the pinned image tags in the sealed manifest (sha vs shrink-id)?
priaya: rollback: immediate abort of transport + reissue manifest pin to previous sealed-manifest SHA and trigger an emergency re-sign. steps: 1) stop deploybot job, 2) unpublish manifest pointer, 3) rollback escort queue to last-good digest, 4) notify customer ops. I put that in the runbook under "private-delivery rollback minimal steps".
sam: on naming: use digest sha256 for the sealed manifest and include shrink-id as metadata field. this avoids human-friendly tag confusion and matches our airgap client resolver. 
jordan: perfect. also, add a canary path: send first 3 escorts (customer mirrors) with --dry-run=false but taped to canary queue. if those succeed for 10m then open full window. if any failure -> automatic rollback. can we wire a short-circuit hook into deploybot?
marco: deploybot supports a preflight hook now. I can add a webhook that checks the first 3 success metrics from the escort-report API. If escort-report shows any HTTP 5xx or signature mismatch, it will call the deploybot abort endpoint. I can have that live in 15m.
tina: one more ops detail — offline installer delta logic: if the delta patch moves too many bytes (>500MB), abort and force full installer. we've seen partial deltas break apply on some on-prem airgap boxes. add that guard.
jordan: agreed. add the delta size guard to verify-submanifest.sh and to the deploybot preflight. whoever touches that update pls push to release branch and ping me.
sam: pushed patch to release/rc2-subchunk and updated verify-submanifest to check delta size. CI passed. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/release/rc2-subchunk (link internal).
priaya: signing run starting now on signer-03. I will paste cosign output when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploybot: [deploybot] packaging step complete: generated manifest.json (sha256:fa12c3...e9), manifest.json.sig created. next: containerize bundles and run escort dry-run for canary targets.
marco: hooking preflight webhook to deploybot now. will post endpoint URL in 2m.
jordan: ok team — once signer confirms and marco's hook is wired, start the canary escorts. i'll be on pager and will watch the first three. if any of us sees problems react with :x: and call it. otherwise, after 10m we open the rest of the window and ship.
priaya: cosign output: ```Signature made for manifest.json
Verified OK
Timestamp: 2026-04-06T23:01:10Z
Key ID: abcd1234``` :white_check_mark:
marco: webhook URL posted privately. preflight rules: cosign verified, delta<=500MB, mirrors reachable, replication <= 30s, all good -> proceed.
jordan: starting canary escorts now. deploybot: kick canary queue. :shipit:
deploybot: [deploybot] canary escorts kicked: targets: cust-mirror-1,cust-mirror-2,cust-mirror-3. monitoring window 10m.
ops-bot: Escort reports incoming: cust-mirror-1 -> 200 OK, signature verified; cust-mirror-2 -> 200 OK, signature verified; cust-mirror-3 -> 503 GatewayTimeout from mirror edge. retrying 1/3.
priaya: cust-mirror-3 still 503. i'm opening a ticket with the mirror operator, but we should treat 503 in canary as a failure and abort per policy.
jordan: aborting per policy. deploybot stop and revert manifest pointer to previous SHA fa0b9d...a1. marco/priaya execute.
marco: calling deploybot abort endpoint... done. deploybot: [deploybot] job aborted by jordan (reason: canary mirror 3 503).
priaya: re-pinned manifest pointer to previous sealed SHA fa0b9d...a1 and reissued notification to customer ops. ticket #ENG-4282 created and assigned to mirror team.
ops-bot: Notification: private delivery aborted. Reason: canary mirror 3 503. Rollback steps executed: deploybot abort, manifest pointer reverted, escort queue cleared. Audit ID: audit-20260406-4102345678.
jordan: thanks everyone. hold here until mirror team confirms fix. once they confirm, we can re-run the canary using the same artifacts. good runbook validation. :clap:
marco: noted lessons: improve mirror health preflight (make it part of the checklist) and add an early parallel health-check to avoid mid-escort aborts. I'll open a follow-up PR.
sam: i'll add an alert rule for repeated 503s during canary in the escort metrics. low effort.
tina: copying these timeline notes into the release notes draft. action items: mirror health preflight, delta size guard (done), webhook abort hook (done), canary failure IRC playbook (doc).
jordan: closing thread for now. will re-open when mirror is green. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
